mechanism: Tretinoin is a potent teratogen (Category X/contraindicated in pregnancy) and progesterone is used for pregnancy support; concurrent use requires strict pregnancy prevention as tretinoin may induce hepatic metabolism affecting progesterone levels.
action: Ensure effective contraception during tretinoin therapy; if progesterone supplementation is needed, monitor progesterone levels and consider alternative retinoids with lower teratogenic potential after careful risk-benefit analysis.
